sourceRecord.description: Cheapest JFK option, but the supplier is hidden. Standard sedan is a good NYC compromise: more trunk than Corolla, easier to park than an SUV. Expect to leave the JetBlue terminal/baggage-claim flow and use AirTrain/signage to Federal Circle/rental-car facilities; build in extra time after landing. Car + NYC tradeoff: Standard sedan is a good NYC compromise: more trunk than Corolla, easier to park than an SUV. NYC reality: driving into Manhattan can be slow, toll-heavy, and stressful; parking/garages can be expensive and tight. A rental only makes sense if they need out-of-Manhattan flexibility, luggage control, or day trips—otherwise taxi/subway/rideshare may be easier.
